info.title: Because I Don't Like My Big Brother at All!!
info.synopsis: Nao è ossessionata dall'amore per il fratello Shuusuke. Questa ossessione, che sfiora l'incesto, la spinge a fare qualsiasi gesto sconsiderato pur di apparire agli occhi del fratello come una donna matura. Come ad esempio piombare nella sua stanza per gettare via tutti i suoi porno! Ma è proprio durante questo processo che trova l'album delle foto di Shuusuke dove è ritratto durante la sua infanzia e scopre che lei non vi compare mai...

Nao goes to great lengths for Shūsuke to think of her perversely by doing things such as letting him purposely look underneath her skirt (and once letting him see her completely naked) but then she always gets him into trouble afterward so as to make it look like Shūsuke is the immoral pervert. One day, while Nao searches through Shūsuke's room for his collection of porn magazines, she then finds a hidden family photo album and is surprised to find out that there are no childhood pictures of her in it. After Shūsuke was finished being scolded about his porn collection, Nao confronts her parents, Shūji and Nanaka, about the album.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis:
It turns out that Nao and Shuusuke are not related by blood. While most people would be upset after finding out something like that, Nao took it in the most positive way possible - it meant that there was nothing to get in the way between her and Shuusuke.

The next day, a new student named Iroha transfers into Nao's class. At first Nao gets along with her really well, and they even end up having lunch together... but while they are eating Shuusuke comes to give Nao her keys which she left at home. Even though Iroha and Shuusuke should be meeting each other for the first time, Iroha seems strangely interested in him...

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: Late on night, Shūsuke spots a sexy cosplayer named Ran Yatagai on top of a vending machine. He later sees Ran, who calls herself Princess Leila, at school the next day, who invites him and his friends to the rooftop. She claims to be seeking a saviour amongst the scum of the Earth in order to defend it, with Shūsuke and friends believe to be initiation for some kind of underground club. Meanwhile, Rin appears and shows romantic interest in Nao, now that Ran is preoccupied.
